claim_text: Lala weakened from a hurricane to a tropical storm on Sunday after passing Hawaii without making landfall, while still producing hurricane-force gusts on the Big Island.
quote: Hurricane Lala weakened to a tropical storm Sunday after skirting Hawaii without making landfall, but it wasn't done punishing the Big Island with hurricane-force gusts.
confidence_justification: Storm classification is an official designation reported consistently by four separate wire outlets in this cluster; at the news ceiling of 0.6.
